services.name: Our Exhibits
services.desc: Our mission is to foster an appreciation of Delmarva’s unique natural and cultural heritage through education, exploration, and enjoyment. The Delmarva Discovery Museum was conceived as a place where visitors could explore the rich history and the natural world of Delmarva, the peninsula comprised of Lower Delaware and the Eastern Shores of Maryland and Virginia. Come explore Delmarva's history and meet the fascinating animals of the Pocomoke River all in one place!
